setup_logging: setup logging for multiple processes with stdout and optional file output to an output directory
get_logger: get a named logger instance or the root logger by name for use in any module
log_json_stats: log a dictionary of statistics as formatted JSON to the logger and optionally to a file
suppress_print: suppress all print output from the current process by replacing builtins.print with a no-op function
cached_log_stream: open a cached log file stream with automatic atexit cleanup and cloud storage buffering support
